skills.name: Desecration
skills.description: Shoots a bolt of dark energy, dealing ~ur~7 Unholy Damage~/~ with Accuracy.##If the spell hits the target, burns its Energy for ~lg~33%~/~ of the damage dealt and replenishes the same amount of Energy to the caster.##Grants Unholy Damage for ~w~8 turns~/~.##This effect doesn't stack.

skills.name: Bone Ward
skills.description: Activates ~lg~"Bone Ward"~/~ for ~w~4~/~ turns (~lg~+1~/~ turn if a corpse is adjacent):##~lg~+12%~/~ Physical Resistance#~lg~+15%~/~ Bleed Resistance#~lg~+10%~/~ Magic Resistance#~lg~+10%~/~ Move Resistance##When the effect expires or is activated again, bone shards deal ~ur~4 Unholy~/~ and ~w~3 Piercing Damage~/~ to all adjacent enemies, with ~w~50%~/~ chance to Stagger them.

skills.name: Summon Skeleton
skills.description: Summon skeleton on the targeted tile (no corpse required).##Duration, Max Health %, and Max Energy % scale with Willpower (starts at ~w~20~/~ turns, ~lg~33%~/~ Max Health / ~lg~25%~/~ Max Energy, Armor Durability ~w~0%~/~).##Only one Skeleton can exist at a time.

skills.name: Essence Leech
skills.description: Devours a targeted corpse or steals ~lg~8%~/~ Max Health and ~lg~8%~/~ Max Energy from an allied Undead or Skeleton, transferring half of them to the caster.##Activates ~lg~"Essence Charge"~/~ for ~w~12–15~/~ turns:##~lg~+5%~/~ Magic Power#~r~-5%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost#~lg~+4~/~ Max Energy##Repeated use grants an extra stack (up to II) and refreshes duration.##Using Spells reduces stacks by ~r~1~/~.

skills.name: Death's Blessing
skills.description: Replenishes Health to the target (based on Magic Power) and improves body part condition by ~lg~25%~/~ of health restored.##~lg~50%~/~ more effective on allied Undead.##Grants ~lg~"Death's Blessing"~/~ for ~w~8~/~ turns:##~lg~+6%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~+6%~/~ Energy Drain#~lg~+8%~/~ Damage Reflection.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.description: Reanimates a targeted corpse as a lasting Undead at ~lg~50–55%~/~ Max Health / ~lg~50%~/~ Max Energy and sets Armor Durability to ~w~0%~/~.##Increases morale (up to ~lg~70%~/~).##Slowly decreases Sanity but no less than ~r~60%~/~.##Can't summon Undead higher than the skill's level cap.##Prevents receiving ~ly~"Blessing"~/~.

skills.name: Grave Blight
skills.description: Creates a blighted 3x3 area on the targeted tile (Range: ~w~5–6~/~) for ~w~4~/~ turns.##Enemies remaining in the area take ~ur~2 Unholy Damage~/~ per turn and gain ~r~-4%~/~ Magic Resistance (stacks up to ~w~3~/~ while inside).##Also allows ~r~"Withering Curse"~/~ to stack up to II; hitting with ~lg~"Desecration"~/~ or repeating the curse adds a stack.##Bodypart worsen becomes ~r~0.35%~/~ per turn per stack.

skills.name: Death Touch
skills.description: Deals ~ur~10–12 Unholy Damage~/~ (Range: ~w~4–5~/~) with Immobilization Chance.##Replenishes Health to all allies within Vision for ~lg~40–50%~/~ of the damage dealt.##If the target has ~r~"Withering Curse"~/~: ~lg~+25%~/~ damage and adds ~w~1~/~ curse stack.##Consuming ~w~1~/~ ~lg~"Essence Charge"~/~ grants ~lg~+15%~/~ Magic Power for this cast only.

skills.name: Corpse Burst
skills.description: Targets a corpse or allied Undead/Skeleton and makes it explode, destroying it.##Deals Unholy and Piercing Damage in a base 3x3 area around the target and has a chance to apply Bleeding to affected enemies.##Damage, Bleeding chance, and area size scale with Willpower (area grows from 3x3 toward 5x5 / 7x7).##Exploding an ally causes a small Sanity loss.

skills.name: Mastery of Binding
skills.description: Unbinding allies doesn't take a turn and replenishes Energy equal to ~lg~10%~/~ of your Magic Power.##Increases the level of summoning abilities by ~lg~1~/~.##Summon Skeleton: ~lg~+4~/~ turns base duration and ~lg~+10%~/~ Max Health / Max Energy.##Resurrection thralls start at ~lg~60%~/~ Max Health.##Still limited to one safe Undead at a time unless a higher-tier skill allows more.

skills.name: Black Sepulchre
skills.description: Detonates ~r~"Withering Curse"~/~ on the target (Range: ~w~5–6~/~), or on the strongest cursed enemy in a 3x3 if cast on a tile: removes stacks, deals ~ur~6 Unholy Damage~/~ × stacks to the target and ~ur~3 Unholy Damage~/~ × stacks to adjacent enemies.##Allows ~r~"Withering Curse"~/~ to stack up to III.##Bodypart worsen becomes ~r~0.5%~/~ per turn per stack while at III.

skills.name: Immortality
skills.description: Prevents dying from lethal hits as long as Max Health and Morale are both higher than ~lg~50%~/~.##When Health drops below ~w~2~/~, replenishes ~lg~33%~/~ of Max Health and Max Energy, and applies:##~r~-10%~/~ Morale#~lg~+2%~/~ Fatigue##Prevents death from starvation or dehydration.

skills.name: Blooming Madness
skills.description: Successfully raising the dead allows you to learn one of their active abilities at a time (while available via skill menu; lost when the thrall dies).##Increases Experience Gain of Undead kills by ~lg~100%~/~.

skills.name: Archtheurgy
skills.description: Casting Spells deals Unholy Damage to all enemies within vision (based on ~lg~3.33%~/~ of Magic Power).##Raising the dead, summoning wraiths, Stealing Essence, or receiving ~lg~"Death's Blessing"~/~ has ~lg~33%~/~ chance to activate ~lg~"Ascension"~/~ for ~w~6~/~ turns:##~lg~+33%~/~ Unholy Resistance#~lg~+66%~/~ Miracle Potency#Converts Unholy Damage into Sacred Damage.

skills.name: Wraith Summoning
skills.description: Summons a Wraith on the targeted tile; power depends on ~lg~"Essence Charge"~/~ stacks.##Removes ~lg~"Essence Charge"~/~.##If no weapon equipped: ~r~-50%~/~ Cooldown Duration and Halves Miscast Chance.##Can't summon Wraiths higher than the skill's level cap.
